citation.authors: Rosmarin D, Passeron T, Pandya AG et al

record.population: 674 people aged 12 or over with nonsegmental vitiligo in North America and Europe (two trials); how many were Black is not in the abstract
record.design: Two phase 3, randomised, double-blind, vehicle-controlled trials of 1.5% ruxolitinib cream twice daily for 24 weeks
record.finding: At week 24, 29.8% (trial 1) and 30.9% (trial 2) on ruxolitinib cream reached a 75% improvement in facial vitiligo score, against 7.4% and 11.4% on vehicle.
